caption: The drawing consists of nine square patterns arranged in a grid on a beige background. The largest square, located in the upper left quadrant, has a tan-colored fill with black lace-like floral and stitched patterns, including a diagonal band with intricate flower shapes and dotted vertical lines scattered across the background. Surrounding this main square are eight smaller squares, each with different black linear or floral designs on a similar tan background. The upper right three squares display vertically oriented stripe-based patterns: the top one has a diamond-filled central stripe flanked by small dots, the middle one features two parallel lines of repeated small eight-petal flower shapes, and the bottom one shows a double wavy line. Below these, to the left, four squares are arranged horizontally. The leftmost has a tessellation of interlocking S-shapes, the next has vertical zigzag lines, the third has four plus-shaped crosses with small corner flourishes, and the rightmost has an allover pattern of leafy, branching vines. All drawn lines and motifs are rendered in black ink.
title: Printed Cottons
